title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Body of every non-2xx JSON response (CONTRACT_SKETCH §2). 'details' never contains tokens, secrets, prompt text or filesystem paths.

message.description: Human-readable, safe to display; not localized; not for parsing.

details.description: Code-specific machine-readable details. Known keys: field, unknown_fields, retry_after_seconds, task_id, command_id, state, received, server_last_seq, checks.
